moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Starlink is licensed in over 165 countries… so why still no license? Is Ambani the real boss of India?
moments.why: Musk’s jab at India’s licensing delay—calling out Mukesh Ambani—has ignited political and business debate.
moments.url: India rejects Musk’s allegations even as Musk escalates attack — Hindustan Times

moments.author: Major League Baseball
moments.quote: MLB proposes return to a 154-game regular season, best‑of‑7 Division Series, and top seeds choosing opponents
moments.why: A radical restructuring of baseball’s season and playoffs—fans and players alike are buzzing.
moments.url: MLB proposes shortening regular season to 154 games in 2029, expanding Division Series to best‑of‑7 — AP News

moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Doctors believe it’s a matter of when, not if, Washington QB Jayden Daniels hurts his left elbow again.
moments.why: An ominous injury prediction for a young QB is sparking major NFL roster and betting speculation.
moments.url: Adam Schefter: there are doctors… hurting his left elbow again. — Reddit (quoted from his X post)
